problems: natalia-republic is split: Cliopatria's single row 'Natalia Republic' 1840..1910 is the Boer republic (1839-1843) and then the British Colony of Natal (1843-1910); the new slug colony-of-natal carries the colony and reviews shapes 1848-1908, so validator warnings of unreviewed shapes appear in both files (7 in natalia-republic, 1 in colony-of-natal); the colour agent should seed colony-of-natal (type colony, family britain).

swaziland and eswatini (Q1050) are written as ONE dossier under the slug swaziland (cliopatria_names Swaziland and Eswatini, 1885-2024, with the 1894-1899 South African Republic protectorate and 1903-1968 British protectorate as vassal events); af-08-l, which also owns the eswatini row in its brief, must not write a second dossier under eswatini or swaziland.

nieuwe-republiek: Cliopatria's shape is in the wrong place (Lubombo country east of Swaziland, 31.7-32.8E, not Vryheid at 30.8E); verdict wrong, corrected to a 66 km circle at Vryheid. Cliopatria's south-african-republic 1890-1899 shapes inherit the same mislocated polygon (and date it 1890 instead of July 1888); corrected there too.

Cross-dossier overlaps for the merger step: zululand (af-07-a) has no 1843 loss of the Buffalo-Tugela country to Natal and its Cliopatria shapes 1840-1897 contain it and the Vryheid land; british-cape-colony's 1877-1884 Transvaal events are mirrored in south-african-republic with counterpart british-cape-colony (Cliopatria's row, not the historical British Crown).

Boer War: the Boer republics are shown as occupied (hatched) from March 1900 (Free State) and June 1900 (Transvaal) to the Treaty of Vereeniging of 31 May 1902, not as dissolved at the 1900 annexations, so that their end year matches the Wikipedia infoboxes; successors orange-river-colony and transvaal-colony need dossiers.

free-orange-state has 13 gazetteer resolve warnings until the region 'Conquered Territory' is added; the corrections for 1854-1868 and the 1858-1869 contest/gain events rest on it. Counterparts 'basutoland', 'transvaal-colony' and 'orange-river-colony' warn as unknown slugs until their dossiers exist.

Ten distinct Wikipedia pages were opened through WebFetch (a summarising relay); quotation marks in the dossiers enclose only sentences the relay presented as quotes, everything else is unquoted paraphrase; the South African Republic page was fetched twice (second time for the president list). Budgets: natalia-republic and colony-of-natal share five pages (Natalia, Colony of Natal, Nieuwe Republiek, Second Boer War, Orange Free State); free-orange-state three; south-african-republic five; nieuwe-republiek one; swaziland two.
